id./param/scenario/cs/b_020_cs_150.pack|cs_: "...That night a guard spotted me and I never found the passage. The King made me polish every suit of armor in the castle.
"Jasper was angry. We had a huge fight... We were always troubling the King back then.
"But it was fun. We truly believed we would carry Heliodor's future together.
"...{var:1}. Forgive my past rudeness. I'm sorry.
"Whoever awaits ahead, I will fight. Lend me your strength so my sword never loses its way again."
